name: io.github.kumarganduri/legwork
title: Legwork
description: Lets your AI find open-source tools on GitHub and install them as sandboxed MCP tools.

packageArguments.name: --allow-read
packageArguments.description: A folder installed tools may read (read-only). Repeatable. Without it they read none of your files.

packageArguments.name: --allow-net
packageArguments.description: Let installed tools use the internet. Off by default.
